report.status_line: Nominal operations with 1 day remaining; static tank water transfer failed, ATVs await fuel, and quadcopter is grounded.

concerns.title: Water transfer failure from static tank to loft tank
concerns.detail: The crew reported that water did not flow when attempting to pump from the static tank to the loft tank before the 10am EVA. Total water remaining is unknown following the static tank refill 5 days ago on 2015-01-17. Today the static tank measured 38 cm from the top, with the level dropping at a measured trend of ~6.3 cm/day (-6.25 cm/day). Estimated water draw since refill is 424.2 L at the FMARS reference rate (12.12 L/person-day) or 87.5 L at the NASA minimum rate (2.5 L/person-day).

concerns.title: ATVs awaiting fuel resupply
concerns.detail: The crew reported that they are awaiting additional fuel for the ATVs, with 1 day remaining until mission end on 2015-01-23.

concerns.title: Quadcopter grounded following contingency
concerns.detail: The commander reported that the quadcopter experienced a contingency on high-risk terrain and will not be able to fly again before the end of the mission on 2015-01-23.

crew_actions: Troubleshoot the static tank transfer pump and inspect plumbing lines to restore water flow to the loft tank.
Provide a new total water volume estimate, as the static tank was refilled 5 days ago on 2015-01-17 and remaining volume is unknown.
Perform post-incident assessment and stow the damaged quadcopter for end-of-mission return.
Clarify in the end-of-mission handover documentation whether incoming crews or the Mars Society provide cleaning supplies.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Determine whether to dispatch ATV fuel resupply before the mission concludes on 2015-01-23.
decisions_for_earth.why: The crew reports awaiting additional fuel for the ATVs with only 1 day remaining in the mission.

report.message_to_earth: Overall status is nominal with 1 day remaining, but water transfer from the static tank to the loft tank failed today. At 10am before the EVA, water did not flow when the crew attempted to pump from the static tank, where the level measured 38 cm from the top. The crew is troubleshooting the transfer pump and inspecting the water lines. Diesel is at 55%, propane is at 31%, ATVs are awaiting fuel, and the quadcopter is grounded after an incident. Please advise by this evening whether ATV fuel will be delivered before mission end on 2015-01-23. Next update will be sent tomorrow morning.
